method: Independent direct HTTP status, redirect, media-type and content-hash checks; audited and regulatory PDF text extraction and visual page verification; SEC browser verification where direct requests were blocked; acquisition-and-exit search

verifiedClaims: RWE's 2025 financial statements list Vela Wind Holdco, LLC as a 25% equity-method associate

Vela Wind Holdco, LLC is the common parent and the four holdcos and project companies are downstream SPVs

The buyer is Altius Renewables and its parent is LS Power Equity Partners Renewable V AIV, L.P.
LS Power completed its acquisition of Algonquin's renewable-energy business on January 8, 2025 and formed Clearlight to manage the acquired operating portfolio
The 2023 Texas PUCT filing shows RWE 25%, Schroders Greencoat 24%, Greencoat Vela and Algonquin 51% in the ownership chain above Stella and Vela Wind Holdco
